answers.core:
The dialog add-on itself should be in the asset library, but the editor prompt has to be in core/editor.
My current implementation of this is to bundle the add-on file inside the editor code, because asset library won't work in offline mode.
We can discuss this and let the editor grab the add-on from asset library later.
